content: Just to clarify, since I see it in the application but not in the announcement or on the website: is March 15 - April 9 the correct date range?
This is the comment thread for #announce > SLMath Workshop: Building the Math. Library of the Future .

To @Rob Lewis yes, thanks, I've added the dates to the announcement and those are the correct dates. It's on the website but you have to look very very carefully :-) It's rather easier to spot on the Axiom page here https://www.slmath.org/axiom (where you can also see that the first two weeks have an overlap with an ML for Mathematics workshop).

Thanks!

Kevin Buzzard said:

It's on the website but you have to look very very carefully :-)

Oh wow, you're right, it's almost invisible on my monitor :see_no_evil:
Will the workshop be open to Berkeley undergraduates? Does this require an application for those who don't need travel funding?
You should ask that question locally. I have no idea about the current relationship between SLMath and UC Berkeley.
Do you have an estimated date for when the applications results will be announced?
Is the application result sent out? Asking because I just received an email about the application result for another AxIOM program.
https://www.slmath.org/axiom/412#members indicates that you got your answer already :smile:
